lines.text: 3.3ClimaticZones
There are three climatic zones on the surface of the Earth. These climatic zones are termed as
tropical, middle latitude and polar. These are primarily based on temperature conditions.
Tropical is hot, middle latitudes are temperate and polar are cold. Each of these climatic zones
has been subdivided into climatic regions on the basis of variations in temperature and moisture
conditions.
A.ClimatesofTropical Zone
These climates have high temperatures and are located in the Tropical region. Their average
monthly temperature is 18C. There are three climatic types located in this zone. These are:
tropical rainforest, tropical desert, and savanna.Abrief description of each is given here.
i)Tropical RainforestClimates:
Tropical rainforest region is a community of animals and plants, developed in hot, wet climatic
conditions of theTropics.
It lies between 5°-10° North and South of Equator. The equator runs through the middle of it.
The main areas of this climatic region are Amazon Basin (South America), Congo Basin (Central
Africa),Singapore,MalaysiaandIndonesia (SouthEastAsia).
Climate of the tropical rainforest region is hot and humid. It is because of high temperature
range of 24C to 32°C throughout the year. The duration of day and night is almost equal, i.e., 12
hours day and 12 hours night. This climatic region receives abundant precipitation as rainfall
accompanied by thunder and lightening.
